dogecoin.text: @KyleMacLeanX I randomly bought $15 worth of Dogecoin in December. Sold it one day later when I learned it was an inflationary meme coin. At the peak, my $15 would have been worth nearly $2,500. 😄

I'm undecided. Months ago I would have said #DeFi . Lately #gaming has been hot. Every day though  #NFTs are selling for thousands. Then we have the meme coins... $DOGE, #SHIB, all the baby coins... Maybe it'll come down to longevity.
